_meta.status: PLACEHOLDER — structural metadata only, no vendor tickers
_meta.why: The original backend/data/series_catalogue*.json files are absent from the repository: the .gitignore pattern `data/` matches backend/data/, so they were never committed. Every regional heatmap module reads its catalogue at import time, so the app could not boot without them.
_meta.generated_from: Indicator names and units were taken from the GROUPS_META literal in the matching frontend page (frontend/src/pages/*Heatmap.tsx).
_meta.simulation_only: ticker_bloomberg and ticker_haver are null everywhere. Simulation mode (ANALYTICS_DATA_SOURCE unset or =csv/simulation) never reads tickers. To run ANALYTICS_DATA_SOURCE=bloomberg|haver, fill in real tickers first.
_meta.inferred_fields: frequency (from units), typical_lag_days (keyword heuristic), dfm_sign, dfm_primary and dfm_factor (from the frontend display group) are inferred, not authoritative. Review before relying on them.
